source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Land Stupor to mesmerize a target, then drop Mortal Coil on them and sweep Soulfire through the pull while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall lands you can stand in front and soak hits, so grab Essence to power every ability.
support.issue: illogical 'so' link: standing in front does not lead to grabbing Essence
support.rewrite: Land Stupor to mesmerize a target, then drop Mortal Coil on them and sweep Soulfire through the pull while your carry follows up. Once Warp Stream and Stonewall land, stand in front to soak hits, and walk over Essence after fights to power up every ability.

midlane.quote: Open with Scar to mark the target, fire Obliterate so the missiles home onto them, and finish the reload with Fate's critical final round. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, trade longer on basic attacks and save Reckoning for a duel you can win.
midlane.issue: Fate's final round comes before the reload, not at the end of it
midlane.rewrite: Open with Scar to mark the target, fire Obliterate so the missiles home onto them, and make the last shot before each reload count, since Fate's final round always crits. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, trade longer on basic attacks and save Reckoning for a duel you can win.

support.quote: Fly Trap pulls enemies to your position; cast it without your team nearby and you just gather them onto yourself.
support.issue: Fly Trap pulls enemies into the planted trap, not to your position
support.rewrite: Fly Trap pulls every nearby enemy into the plant and stuns them; cast it when your team is close enough to follow up, not alone.
